svg.title: BOSS — primary lockup (v2.3 · tagline lock)
svg.desc: Integrated wordmark (B + constellation-O + S + S) above stone rule above tagline "The business process harness" in italic serif. Canonical primary logo as of v2.2 lockup-as-primary decision. v2.3 locks new tagline replacing "Business Orchestration System Sentinel" (v2 acronym expansion) — BOSS shifts from acronym to brand name. New tagline carries Steve | Systems & AI external validator framing ("AI agents need a harness · the visible part gets built first · the surrounding system determines whether it survives") + rig substrate-shape alignment (the rig was originally called "the harness" before 2026-04-29 RIG vocabulary lock) + Process Events (PEGS PE) atomic primitive framing. Brand v2 tokens preserved.
